# ReviewSmart - Independent Product Reviews & Shopping Guides

> ReviewSmart provides independent, hands-on product testing, expert reviews, and buying guides to help consumers make confident purchase decisions.

## Editorial Guidelines & Integrity
- All products evaluated through hands-on testing and controlled laboratory research.
- Strict editorial independence: No sponsored reviews or paid placements accepted from manufacturers.
